Author: PriestKos
Name: Babel14
Punchline: Two-way chat translation powered by an LLM.
Description: Translate incoming and outgoing chat between languages using an LLM API. Toggle with /babel.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Blackjack14
Punchline: Player-run blackjack on /random or /dice: you pick the moves, it rolls, plays the dealer and scores.
Description: Plays player-run blackjack with /random 10 in say range or by tell, or /dice 10 in party or alliance. You press Deal, Hit, Stand, Double or Split; it rolls the cards, reads the results from chat, draws the dealer to 17 and settles the round in units, posting the result to any mix of Echo, Say, Party, Alliance and Tell. Nothing rolls without a button press, and never more than once every 2 seconds.

Author: PriestKos
Name: FF14 Mod Manager Bridge
Punchline: Lets the FF14 Mod Manager desktop app see your character and apply designs and mods.
Description: Companion to the FF14 Mod Manager Windows app. Answers over a local, current-user-only named pipe: who you are, which Penumbra collection is on you, and applies Glamourer designs or toggles Penumbra mods on request.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Inventory Search Bar
Punchline: Adds a search bar directly in the inventory window to filter items.
Description:
Supports different types of filters to be able to find items by name, type, supported job or level requirements.

Supported Inventories:
	- Character Inventory
	- Chocobo Saddlebags
	- Retainer Inventory
	- Armoury
Changelog:
# 1.9.8.1 (PriestKos fork)

- Fixed the crash on game exit: Dispose no longer touches inventory windows while the game is closing, and clearing highlights re-resolves the window instead of using a stale pointer.
- Fixed off-by-one node-list bounds checks and added missing node null checks.
- Builds against Dalamud 15.0.4 (CriticalCommonLib updated).

Author: PriestKos
Name: KeyboundAssist
Punchline: Fills the Keybound Brawler prompt for you; you press Enter.
Description: For research use only. Reads the enemy prompts in the Keybound Brawler duty and writes the shortest one into the activity's own text field, one character at a time, stopping as soon as the word is complete. It never sends a keystroke: the player presses Enter to submit each word, and typing pauses while the duty prohibits input. An optional setting, off by default, sends the finished word itself after a randomised delay.

Author: PriestKos
Name: KosHome

Author: PriestKos
Name: StripDeathroll14
Punchline: Strip Deathroll host helper: turn order, roll calls, wrong-roll alerts, lives and round history.
Description: Hosts Strip Deathroll at a venue. Choose Private (say) or Public (party/alliance), build the player list from your party or by name, and it reads everyone's /random or /dice from chat: the highest opening roll starts round 1, later rounds resume with the player after the winner, the turn goes down your list, each player is called to roll the previous number, a 0, 1, 69 or 666 wins the round, and the winner picks who loses which piece (top, bottom or shoes). It alerts on a wrong number (and calls the player once to reroll) or an out-of-turn roll, keeps every roll of every round and every game (Game 1, Game 2...) with a running tally and CSV export, lets you fix or add a missed roll in the round in play, can remind a player who has not rolled (once in chat with a toast for you, then every 10 seconds in your Echo, rippling their circle), has a debug mode with dummy players, and posts your rules and ad texts. Lines are posted only when you press Post unless you turn on auto-post (for the kinds of line you choose) or reminders, one at a time, a random 2 to 4 seconds apart by default, within limits you pick.
